text:
Coaching institutes lose admissions after the demo class, not before it.

The student liked the class. But the student doesn't decide. The parent does, and the parent wasn't in the room.

What works (and costs nothing):
→ Day 0: a WhatsApp to the parent with the child's name, one real strength, one gap to work on
→ Day 1: last year's results in one image
→ Day 3: seats left in the batch, fees, EMI option

Why WhatsApp and not calls? Parents don't pick up during office hours. They read messages at 9 pm.

If you run 3+ branches, the same sequence works only if every counsellor sends it. That's where automation helps: same message, same day, every enquiry.

What's your demo-to-admission rate? Most institutes I ask have never counted it.
